jobs.title: Director of Brand Marketing
jobs.description:
Department:
Marketing

Reports To:
VP of Integrated Marketing

Direct Reports:
Brand Marketing Managers, Social Media Managers and Coordinators, and supporting Brand team members

Employment Type:
Full-Time

Location:
Remote

Annual Base Salary:
$160,000–$180,000, based on experience and qualifications

About Bask & Lather

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

About The Role

We are seeking a strategic, creative and execution-oriented Director of Brand Marketing to lead brand positioning, product marketing, integrated campaigns, go-to-market planning and organic social. Reporting to the VP of Integrated Marketing, this leader directly manages the Brand and Social teams and translates business objectives and consumer insights into compelling strategies and dependable execution.

This role combines exceptional creative judgment, commercial awareness and operational discipline. You will independently develop recommendations, lead approved plans through completion, develop your team and verify that work meets quality standards. You will identify resource needs early, resolve dependencies and escalate risks before they affect delivery.

Scope and Partnership

The VP of Integrated Marketing owns the broader function, investment priorities, resource allocation and overall performance. The Director owns Brand and Social strategy and delivery within that direction. Channel leaders own their forecasts, resources and execution commitments; Finance consolidates and validates forecasts and economics. This role integrates those inputs into one actionable launch and campaign plan.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy and Consumer Insights

Define brand positioning, messaging, consumer value propositions and competitive differentiation. Build annual and quarterly plans aligned with business priorities.
Identify priority consumers, unmet needs, purchase motivations, barriers and reasons to switch. Translate research, customer feedback, category trends and cultural insights into actionable decisions.
Develop SKU-level competitive analysis covering positioning, pricing, size, benefits and supported advantages. Clarify each product’s role within the portfolio and its relationship to existing products.
Proactively identify research and data gaps, evaluate providers and present recommendations covering scope, cost, timing and business value. Advance work using available evidence while clearly identifying assumptions.

Product Marketing and Go-to-Market

Own integrated GTM strategies for collections, product launches and major initiatives, from consumer opportunity through postlaunch support.
Define the target consumer, purchase rationale, SKU positioning, competitive differentiation, hero products, product routines, messaging and activation strategy.
Translate strategy into channel-specific briefs, asset requirements, launch phases, budgets and measurement plans with named owners, deadlines, dependencies and approvals.
Partner with Product Development, Operations, Supply Chain, Creative, Growth, E-Commerce, Retail and PR to validate specifications, claims, inventory readiness, distribution assumptions and launch feasibility.
Verify that approved assets are accurate, usable, delivered on time and received by executing teams. Maintain readiness gates and contingency plans, and sustain adoption after launch.

Integrated Campaigns and Creative Strategy

Develop compelling campaign concepts, storytelling platforms and creative briefs grounded in consumer insights and product benefits.
Lead coordinated campaigns across paid, owned, earned, retail and experiential touchpoints with Creative, Growth, Social, Influencer, PR and Experiential partners.
Translate strategy into specific production plans, shot lists, creator briefs and channel deliverables. Maintain consistent positioning while adapting execution to each audience and platform.
Apply strong creative judgment to copy, imagery, demonstrations and content. Coordinate required claims, permissions and usage-rights approvals with appropriate partners.

Social Strategy and Publishing Operations

Own organic social strategy, defining each platform’s audience, purpose, content pillars, publishing cadence and performance objectives.
Lead a social calendar balancing education, demonstrations, consumer results, cultural relevance, community and promotional priorities. Maintain a rolling four-week pipeline of approved and scheduled content, with flexibility for timely opportunities.
Establish mandatory content reviews and quality checks for brand alignment, accuracy, sizing, cropping, captions, product tags, shoppable links and live presentation.
Verify scheduled content publishes correctly, including weekends and holidays. Establish named primary and backup owners, account access, training and documented workflows.
Oversee community management, response standards and escalation. Partner with Growth on social commerce, affiliate content and paid amplification with clear deliverable ownership.
Use platform analytics and structured tests to improve content, timing, formats and resource allocation. Connect engagement to relevant audience, product discovery, qualified traffic and commercial outcomes.

Retail and Omnichannel Marketing

Develop coordinated brand initiatives supporting DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop, national retail and international expansion.
Partner with Retail and Growth on retailer-specific launch support, merchandising messages, education and consumer activations based on confirmed plans.
Adapt campaigns to regional audiences with relevant partners while preserving brand positioning and approved product messaging.

Budgets Measurement and Delivery

Own departmental campaign plans, timelines and budgets within approved investment priorities. Justify significant shoots, partnerships, events and other spending through clear objectives, costs, deliverables, distribution plans and expected outcomes.
Maintain an initiative tracker with accountable owners, dependencies, approval status and evidence of completion. Report accurately, distinguish pending commitments from completed work and escalate risks with recommended solutions.
Measure brand health, awareness, consideration, product adoption, social performance, launch readiness, on-time delivery and budget performance. Assess commercial impact with Growth, channel owners and Finance.
Lead postlaunch and campaign reviews that explain results, investment effectiveness, execution gaps and changes required for future initiatives.

Leadership And Qualifications

Team Leadership

Lead, coach and develop Brand and Social team members. Translate priorities into clear assignments, realistic workloads, deadlines and approval requirements.
Provide timely decisions, constructive feedback and respectful communication. Address performance gaps directly and build team capability and independent judgment.
Take ownership of departmental decisions and results when work is delegated. Maintain backup coverage and continuity through absences, turnover and changing priorities.
Identify staffing, agency and production needs early and present actionable recommendations. Manage external partners against agreed scope, quality, budget and deadlines.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in brand, integrated or consumer marketing, including substantial experience leading teams and complex cross-functional initiatives.
Experience in beauty, haircare, personal care or closely relevant CPG, with demonstrated ownership of product launches from insight and positioning through execution and evaluation.
Proven success developing consumer-led positioning, integrated campaigns and creative briefs, with clear examples of personal contribution and business results.
Direct experience managing social teams and publishing operations, creative quality, community engagement and shoppable content.
Experience across digital commerce and national retail, with strong analytical judgment and an understanding of channel economics and measurement limitations.
Demonstrated budget ownership, investment evaluation, vendor management and proactive resource planning.
Strong people leadership, communication, prioritization and project management skills. Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced business with evolving processes and incomplete information.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience scaling brands through national retail expansion, including Walmart, Target, Ulta Beauty or comparable retailers.
Deep understanding of textured haircare and multicultural beauty consumers.
Experience with culturally relevant campaigns, creator or celebrity partnerships, brand collaborations and international market adaptation.

The Ideal Candidate

You connect consumer insight, product differentiation and strong creative thinking to plans that teams can execute. You take ownership, communicate clearly, develop people and follow through. You can explain both the strategy behind a campaign and the operating details that ensure it reaches consumers effectively.

Equal Employment Opportunity

jobs.title: Brand Marketing Manager, Outbound Marketing, Amazon Devices
jobs.description:
Description

We're looking for a Marketing Manager to join the Amazon Devices Outbound Marketing team, supporting Kindle. This newly established team drives brand creative campaigns across paid digital, paid social, influencer, brand partnerships, and brand activations — all in service of key business priorities.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional role. You'll lead media plan execution, shape creative strategy in real time, and act as the connective tissue between our internal teams and agency partners. You'll also bring a sharp cultural instinct — helping the Kindle brand show up in the moments and spaces that matter most to our customers.

Key job responsibilities

Lead elements of media plan execution including variant mapping, comms planning, and real-time creative optimization strategy
Translate business signals from established review meetings into proactive marketing recommendations that support business goals
Liaise across sales, Amazon-owned surfaces, organic social, and media teams to find synergies, maximize creative value, and drive campaign impact
Support management of media and influencer agency partners
Partner with PR and organic social teams to bring key consumer messages to life across channels
Champion campaign work cross-functionally — communicate strategy clearly and early to stakeholders upstream
Act as a culture curator: proactively identify ways the Kindle brand can participate in and shape culture against our customers' priority passion points
Up to 15% domestic travel (e.g., agency on-sites, shoots, brand activations)

A day in the life

Morning — Creative Performance Review You lead a cross-functional meeting with the Amazon.com team. You identify the top-performing asset and recommend it for Amazon.com. You align the room and own next steps.

Midday — Media Optimization You run the weekly optimization session with the agency. You direct spend toward top-performing channels and own the rationale.

Afternoon — Monthly Business Review You sit in on the MBR where sales shares last month's performance. A Kindle feature is outperforming. You connect the dots and brief the social team to produce more content around it. You don't wait to be told.

About The Team

The Amazon Devices Outbound Marketing team is a team of 5 responsible for driving brand creative campaigns that support key business priorities across Kindle, tablets, eReader, and Kids+. We work across paid digital, paid social, influencer, brand partnerships, and brand activations — partnering closely with sales, organic social, PR, and media teams. We're building something from the ground up, which means you'll have real ownership and a seat at the table from day one.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
Experience communicating results to senior leadership
Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels
Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience creating and executing integrated marketing lead generation campaigns using tactics that include live or virtual events, webinars, email, lead nurture programs, and CRM/sales insights
Experience with Salesforce and Tableau
Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process
Experience in consumer electronics or technology sector
Experience in a creative role understanding consumer trends and creating content
Demonstrated history of inserting brands into cultural moments or building culturally relevant campaigns

jobs.description:
Revenue Operations

About Entelligence

Entelligence is a technology-enabled services company that partners with leading SaaS organizations to deliver complex implementations, scale operations, and drive customer success. Through our white-label talent delivery platform, we provide highly skilled, on-demand experts that help our customers execute critical initiatives with speed, precision, and reliability.

We are a values-driven organization and a Great Place to Work® Certified company, focused on building high-performing teams, delivering exceptional customer outcomes, and continuously improving how we operate.

How We Operate

At Entelligence, how we work is just as important as what we deliver. Our values guide how we make decisions, collaborate, and show up every day:

Grit: We persevere through complexity and follow through on what matters. We take ownership, solve problems, and stay committed to delivering results, even when things are challenging.
Customer Obsession: We prioritize outcomes that earn trust and keep it. We anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and hold ourselves accountable to delivering meaningful impact for our customers.
Courage: We take initiative and lead with purpose. We speak up, challenge assumptions, and make decisions that move the business forward.
Speed: We move quickly and decisively while maintaining quality. We prioritize what matters, act with urgency, and execute with intention.
Hungry: We are self-motivated and driven to improve. We seek feedback, take on more, and continuously look for ways to grow, learn, and add value.

Position Summary

The Director of Marketing reports to the Chief Revenue Officer and leads the strategy, execution, and scaling of Entelligence’s marketing function to drive qualified revenue pipeline, support talent acquisition, and elevate the brand across all channels.

This hands-on leadership role owns demand generation, brand and content strategy, sales enablement, partner marketing, and marketing operations across our technology services portfolio, and positions Entelligence as a trusted technology services leader.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Leadership

Plan, build, launch, and optimize multi-channel marketing campaigns across email, digital advertising, social media, content, webinars, and events
Develop and execute the marketing strategy aligned with company growth objectives, service offerings, and target markets
Translate Entelligence's brand, messaging, and positioning into campaigns, collateral, content, and applied marketing assets
Lead, develop, and manage the marketing team, establishing priorities, performance expectations, and professional development plans
Build annual marketing plans, budgets, and operational objectives that support business growth
Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and customer insights to identify new growth opportunities and refine marketing strategy

Sales Enablement & Cross-Functional Leadership

Develop and maintain a library of sales enablement materials, presentations, case studies, and messaging that support business development and customer engagement
Translate positioning and value propositions into practical assets that can be used in conversations with ISVs and channel partners
Develop and optimize the end-to-end lead journey by partnering with Sales to define lead qualification and MQL-to-SQL transition criteria, while designing targeted nurture and re-engagement programs that drive qualified pipeline growth
Manage external agencies, contractors, and marketing vendors while ensuring quality, budget adherence, and measurable outcomes
Contribute to strategic planning and organizational initiatives that improve market awareness, customer acquisition, and company growth

Demand Generation & Pipeline Growth

Build and manage demand generation programs (paid and unpaid) that create a qualified pipeline across strategic accounts and service offerings
Develop and execute outbound marketing campaigns that increase brand awareness, customer engagement, and pipeline generation
Partner with Revenue and Partnerships teams to develop account-based marketing strategies and go-to-market initiatives
Manage campaign execution across digital, outbound, events, partner marketing, and integrated marketing channels
Analyze campaign performance and make ongoing optimization decisions based on results

Brand, Website & Content Strategy

Own a consistent content production cadence focused on increasing awareness, improving search visibility, and supporting go-to-market priorities
Produce SEO/AEO-focused blog content and other awareness assets on a recurring basis
Develop thought leadership and market-facing content focused on ISV, channel, technology, and industry topics
Strategize, develop and produce customer success stories, case studies, webinars, partner content, video content, and other proof points that support credibility and business development

Marketing Operations & Analytics

Own the marketing technology stack, including HubSpot campaigns, emails, website, landing pages, forms, dashboards, audience segmentation, automation, integrations, and data quality
Develop and maintain marketing KPI dashboards, executive reporting, and performance metrics that measure pipeline contribution, campaign effectiveness, and return on investment
Analyze marketing performance and operational processes to identify opportunities to improve automation, reporting, efficiency, and customer engagement, translating insights into actionable recommendations that increase ROI and pipeline contribution
Audit and optimize the CRM contact database, establish audience segmentation frameworks, and build targeted nurture and re-engagement campaigns to drive pipeline growth

Recruitment & Category Marketing

Partner with Talent Acquisition to develop recruitment marketing campaigns that strengthen employer branding and support hiring initiatives
Develop category marketing strategies that position Entelligence's practices, service offerings, and technical expertise within target markets
Create messaging and campaigns that support solution launches, service differentiation, and market expansion
Manage the company-wide monthly newsletter to promote a healthy, connected, and encouraging workplace culture, while contributing ideas and initiatives that support employee engagement and retention

Partner Marketing

Develop joint marketing initiatives with Broadcom and other strategic technology partners
Support partner events, campaigns, co-marketing programs, and alliance initiatives that strengthen market visibility and customer engagement
Align marketing activities with partner priorities and business development objectives
Monitor relevant technology, ISV, channel, and industry trends to identify opportunities for differentiated positioning and content

Required Qualifications

Experience supporting partner-led or channel-driven go-to-market models
5yrs+ experience managing marketing operations for consulting services or information technology environments
2yrs+ additional experience leading or managing marketing functions in a B2B environment
Experience driving demand generation and pipeline growth for consulting services or information technology audiences
Experience working closely with sales or revenue teams in a growth-oriented organization
Strong expertise with marketing tools, CRM systems, and campaign execution platforms
Ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities simultaneously

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with enterprise sales cycles and account-based marketing strategies
Experience building or scaling marketing programs in a growing organization
Experience working with data-driven marketing and performance measurement

Required Skills

Marketing Operations: Ability to manage marketing platforms, automation, CRM integration, reporting, and campaign operations that improve organizational efficiency
Sales Enablement: Ability to develop content, messaging, and enablement materials that support revenue generation and customer engagement
Digital & Outbound Marketing: Ability to execute integrated digital, outbound, website, and email marketing campaigns that generate qualified demand
Recruitment & Employer Branding: Ability to develop recruitment marketing initiatives that strengthen employer brand awareness and attract top talent
Category & Solution Marketing: Ability to position service offerings, technical practices, and strategic solutions within target markets through differentiated messaging

Why Entelligence

Entelligence offers the opportunity to work in a values-driven, technology-focused organization that partners with leading companies to deliver complex, high-impact solutions. As the company continues to grow, this role will play an important part in building the marketing function, establishing the processes and programs that support the business today, and helping shape the team and capabilities needed for the future. With a long-standing history, stable growth, and a strong commitment to professional development, Entelligence provides an environment where individuals can build meaningful careers while making a measurable impact.

Position: Marketing Manager

Reports to: Vice President of Marketing & Public Relations

FLSA: Full-Time Exempt

Location: Corporate Office, Las Vegas, Nevada

Compensation: Salary commensurate with experience

WAHLBURGERS: Where Real Eats Meet Real People.

Born at the Wahlberg family kitchen table, we're all about great food, real connections, and genuine vibes. At Wahlburgers, we're not just serving up burgers; we're crafting a menu inspired by real, family dishes from the Wahlberg kitchen. Each dish is a nod to the flavors and memories that filled Mark, Donnie, and Paul's home growing up—traditions they've shared their whole lives. We bring craveable flavor, a menu with heart, and a whole lot of fun to keep our guests smiling and coming back for more. So, pull up a chair, bring your appetite, and join the Wahlburgers family for a good time, every time.

Job Summary

The Marketing Manager leads day-to-day marketing execution for Wahlburgers across corporate and franchise locations, including digital channels, WahlClub and CRM, gift cards, third-party delivery, and local store marketing (LSM). This role executes the Digital and WahlClub road maps, manages marketing calendars, and oversees monthly channel reporting.

Working directly with the VP of Marketing & PR, the Marketing Manager plays a hands-on role within a lean, high-output team. The ideal candidate plans ahead, brings data-driven recommendations, and translates brand strategy into marketing initiatives that drive sales at the store level.

Job Responsibilities

Key Performance Elements / Essential Functions

The functions listed below are representative, but not necessarily exhaustive, of this position. Management may assign other functions not listed herein at its sole discretion.

Digital Road Map & Reporting

Execute and maintain phased, budgeted Digital and WahlClub Road Maps aligned with brand strategy and sales goals, with initiatives scheduled in advance.
Own monthly channel KPI reporting, including performance insights and recommended actions.
Develop digital and local store marketing (LSM) strategy and content for Annual Digital Road Map, new store opening (NSO), and QBU presentations.

Website, SEO, Paid Media & Online Ordering

Manage wahlburgers.com and direct the digital agency on website performance, creative updates, and compliance, ensuring promotions and featured items remain

current.

Lead search engine optimization (SEO) efforts with measurable performance goals.
Optimize online menus and the ordering experience across Olo Ordering, Pay, Delivery, Catering, and Rails to increase add-on purchases and average check size.
Direct the digital agency’s paid social advertising on Meta and paid search and Performance Max campaigns on Google, including budget pacing and return on ad spend (ROAS).

Listings & Local Pages

Manage location information, local pages, and listings across Google, Yelp, Bing, and Tripadvisor through SOCi, keeping features, menu details, and photos current.

WahlClub / CRM

Manage WahlClub through Olo Engage, overseeing program performance, offers, segmentation, messaging, and the app experience.
Execute the member acquisition offer, member-only surprise-and-delight initiatives, and controls to prevent fraudulent offer issuance.
Plan and deploy targeted email and SMS campaigns on a consistent schedule, with a baseline of two targeted messages per week across dine-in, takeout, delivery, catering, and Wahlburgers At Home.
Report monthly on WahlClub campaign performance and analyze competitor programs to inform quarterly promotional plans.

Third-Party Delivery & Catering

Manage storefront merchandising, promotions, and performance across DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, and ezCater.
Develop marketplace partnerships and provide monthly return on investment (ROI) reporting with recommendations to continue or adjust initiatives.

Gift Card & Comp Programs

Execute gift card strategy and sales initiatives through Paytronix and Olo, including holiday, bonus card, and comp card programs.
Drive gift card sales through in-store merchandising, marketing campaigns, team member contests, and retail distribution partnerships.
Analyze program performance to improve promotions and identify new sales opportunities.

Local Store Marketing (LSM)

Develop and execute LSM strategy for corporate locations, including partnerships with shopping centers, casinos, and venues.
Create and maintain the franchisee LSM toolkit, including a playbook, templates, and approved assets for community events, schools, sports, and local partnerships.
Lead LSM for new store openings, including pre-opening community outreach, grand opening plans, and local media support in partnership with the VP of Marketing & PR.
Coordinate store-level execution with General Managers, franchisees, and Operations; track spending and results by location; and share best practices across the system.

Marketing Calendars & Brand Team Support

Develop and maintain annual, quarterly, and monthly marketing calendars.
Lead digital onboarding for new store openings (NSOs), including online ordering, business listings, loyalty programs, and gift card setup.
Contribute content to the WahlStreet Journal, the biweekly franchise newsletter.
Create presentation decks and support system-wide marketing campaigns, promotions, and competitive research.

Skills + Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required.
5–7+ years of experience in digital, CRM, or field marketing, including multi-unit restaurant or franchise experience supporting both corporate and franchise locations.
Hands-on experience with the Olo suite, loyalty and gift card platforms such as Paytronix, and listings management tools such as SOCi. Familiarity with POS systems is a plus.
Proven local store marketing (LSM) experience, including community partnerships, grand openings, and franchisee toolkits.
Experience directing digital and creative agencies and managing vendor relationships.
Proactive planning skills, with the ability to anticipate deadlines and manage projects, priorities, and marketing calendars. Strong organizational, time management, and communication skills.
Experience reporting on return on ad spend (ROAS) and key performance indicators (KPIs), with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable recommendations.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, as well as AI tools and content management systems.
Office-based at the corporate office in Las Vegas, Nevada.

We work with category-defining companies - from the largest AI labs in the world to ISVs - building joint go-to-market programs that drive customer adoption and revenue.

We value marketers who combine strategic thinking with execution intensity, can navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving domain, and measure their success by the pipeline they create rather than the programs they run. This is a builder role in a builder team - you will be creating motions that do not yet exist.

Experience with marketing budget development, spend allocation, lead generation, traffic performance analysis, and sales support strategies.

Comprehensive understanding of field marketing strategy, budget management, digital advertising, lead generation, and traffic performance metrics.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate performance data into actionable marketing recommendations.

Strong leadership, coaching, and team development skills.
Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills for reporting to senior leadership and division stakeholders.
Ability to manage competing priorities, lead through ambiguity, and coordinate work through cross-functional partnerships.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, marketing analytics tools, and budget management or reporting systems.

Work is performed in a combination of office and field environments.

Job Overview

The Director of Marketing provides strategic and operational leadership for Unity Environmental University’s marketing efforts, translating institutional priorities into integrated campaigns that strengthen brand awareness and clearly communicate Unity’s distinctive value. Working across the University’s portfolio of online and in-person educational offerings as well as its Sustainable Ventures, the Director leads campaign planning and execution, digital marketing, content strategy, brand management, audience segmentation, and performance measurement. This position supervises marketing staff and external partners, manages budgets and project timelines, and collaborates closely with recruitment, academic, creative, and institutional leaders to ensure marketing initiatives are coordinated, audience-centered, data-informed, and aligned with the University’s mission and growth objectives.

This role is funded through Research and Development in order to create institutional bandwidth. It begins with a structured learning period of a minimum of three to six months in which the incumbent shadows and learns from the Chief Marketing Officer. Specific tasks and projects are assigned during that period. Following the learning period, the incumbent is assigned a portfolio, either at the Enterprise level or dedicated to a subsidiary or SEBU, based on institutional need. Any portfolio assigned remains within the scope of this role. The portfolio assignment and any reports are determined by the institution and are not fixed at the time of hire.

Position Specific Responsibilities And Expectations

Work with the CMO to develop and execute marketing strategies that strengthen the Unity Environmental University brand and support the growth and visibility of its individual colleges.
Establish clear positioning, value propositions, and audience strategies for each college while ensuring alignment with the University’s overarching identity.
Build greater awareness and understanding of Unity’s distinct educational models, academic offerings, mission, and competitive advantages.
Partner with college and University leaders to identify growth opportunities and develop marketing strategies that support their goals.
Lead institutional and college-level campaigns across digital advertising, web, email, social media, content, print, video, and other appropriate channels.
Direct the development of messaging and creative assets that clearly and consistently communicate the identity and value of the University and its colleges.
Use market research, competitive analysis, audience insights, and industry trends to guide brand positioning and marketing decisions.
Establish brand-awareness and campaign-performance measures, analyze results, and adjust strategies to improve reach, engagement, and impact.
Partner with the CMO on website strategy, search engine optimization, AI-search optimization, and digital-content initiatives that strengthen visibility and audience engagement.
Oversee institutional and college-level social media strategy, content planning, publishing standards, and performance measurement.
Maintain and enforce University brand standards across institutional, University, academic, and promotional materials.
Coordinate marketing support for new SEBUs, academic programs, partnerships, events, and other strategic University initiatives.
Work with the CMO on the development of video, photography, web, email, print, and social media assets.
Work with external agencies, consultants, media partners, and vendors to ensure work meets established expectations, timelines, budgets, and brand standards.
Establish effective workflows, project-management practices, and quality-control standards for marketing initiatives and deliverables.

jobs.description:
About Dialpad

Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.

Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.

Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.

Being a Dialer

At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.

We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.

We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits: Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic
.

Your role

The ISV & Strategic Alliances Sr. Partner Marketing Manager leads high-impact partner marketing programs that drive measurable pipeline and revenue growth through Dialpad's strategic technology and alliance partnerships. This role primarily supports the Google Cloud partnership globally and T-Mobile for Business nationally, while helping accelerate growth across Dialpad's broader ISV and Strategic Alliance ecosystem.

This position partners closely with Channel Sales and strategic partners to develop and execute integrated partner marketing strategies and joint go-to-market programs that drive partner engagement, pipeline, and overall revenue growth. The role ensures partner marketing investments and initiatives align with shared business priorities while continuously improving processes, measurement, and operating practices to scale impact.

This position reports to the Sr. Manager, Partner Marketing (Head of Partner Marketing).

What You’ll Do

Lead annual and quarterly partner marketing plans for Google Cloud globally and T-Mobile for Business nationally, aligning co-marketing programs to revenue targets, partner priorities, product strategy, and regional opportunities.
Develop strategic partner marketing programs and repeatable go-to-market plays, including Workspace-led displacement, enterprise voice, contact center, Google Cloud Marketplace, and other joint solution motions that drive partner engagement, pipeline, and revenue.
Build scalable co-marketing frameworks and best practices that strengthen partner activation, improve efficiency, and extend to additional ISV and Strategic Alliance partners as the business evolves.
Develop integrated, account-based go-to-market campaigns with strategic partners and Dialpad Channel Sales, aligning on target accounts, strategy, messaging, roles, and execution across content, webinars, email, social, landing pages, customer proof, and other channels.
Create scalable campaign assets and partner enablement resources, including joint value propositions, discovery guides, objection-handling content, and other seller-facing materials, in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Lead high-touch executive and customer programs, including executive dinners, roundtables, workshops, and regional experiences, from audience strategy through execution, and marketing ROI reporting.
Develop customer advocacy programs featuring joint customer stories, strategic partner wins, and executive testimonials that strengthen credibility and support joint go-to-market efforts.
Manage partner marketing budgets and quarterly investment plans, including MDF strategy, allocation, and optimization, to maximize ROI and business impact.
Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks to track marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, partner engagement, campaign performance, and overall program impact.
Oversee partner-facing content and campaign development to ensure consistency, quality, and alignment with Dialpad's brand, product positioning, and joint partner messaging.
Identify opportunities to improve partner marketing processes, tools, systems, and workflows, while sharing insights and best practices to strengthen scalability, efficiency, and partner-led growth.

Skills You’ll Bring

5–8+ years of partner marketing experience within a technology, channel, alliance, or similar partner ecosystem.
Direct Google Cloud partner marketing experience is required, with a strong preference for experience across Google Workspace, Gemini, Google Cloud Marketplace, or other Google Cloud solutions.
Experience in marketing with T-Mobile, telecommunications carriers, resellers, or comparable strategic partners is strongly preferred.
Strong experience developing partner pipeline growth strategies and executing integrated demand generation programs across channels, including partner seller activation, compliant seller incentives, executive and customer events, webinars, sponsorships, digital campaigns, and other tactics that engage partner sellers, account teams, and channel organizations.
Experience developing, managing, and optimizing MDF or partner marketing investments to maximize business impact and return on investment.
Ability to translate technical, cloud, AI, marketplace, and platform capabilities into clear customer and seller value propositions, including identifying relevant use cases, personas, industries, and joint solution opportunities.
Strong analytical and business acumen, with experience defining KPIs, measuring partner program performance, interpreting results, and using data to optimize programs.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce and marketing automation platforms, including campaign tracking, attribution, reporting, and performance measurement.
Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex, high-priority partner initiatives simultaneously.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the executive presence and influence required to work effectively with senior internal stakeholders, sales leaders, and external partner executives.
Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a strong focus on continuous improvement, operational excellence, and measurable partner-led pipeline and revenue growth.

Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications

Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth

We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. We have designed our offices to be inclusive, offering a vibrant environment to cultivate collaboration and connection. Our exceptional culture, repeatedly recognized as a Great Place to Work, ensures that every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success.

Join Galaxy Desserts

Galaxy Desserts, also known as Brioche Pasquier | Galaxy Desserts, is part of the Brioche Pasquier family of bakers, based in France. What really sets us apart is that we do all the crafting, baking, freezing and packaging ourselves. We carry three families of products: (1) Brioche; (2) Croissants; (3) Frozen Desserts, all dedicated to excellence and quality for Retail and Food Service. Our products are either made in France or manufactured at our facility in Richmond, California. Intensely committed to quality, we try and source all of our ingredients from the best producers we can find. We endeavor to mitigate our environmental impact and support our community every day.

Our core values are based on RESPECT: Recognition, Executive, Simplicity, Passion, Equality, Closeness, and Transparency. They shape our company culture and guide our business strategy. They bring together our employees and are integrated in our everyday work practices.

Summary

We are seeking an organized, analytical, and creative Marketing Coordinator to support product strategy, product-development initiatives, and promotional programs for our retail and food-service product families. This role helps bring products to market by supporting brand positioning, product messaging, new-product launches, packaging development, merchandising recommendations, and customer- and consumer-facing marketing tools.

The Marketing Coordinator works closely with Marketing, Sales, Inside Sales, Research & Development, Quality Assurance, and other cross-functional teams to develop materials and programs that strengthen product visibility, support sales growth, and respond to customer and consumer needs. The successful candidate will analyze sales performance, market trends, customer insights, consumer preferences, and competitor activity to identify opportunities and make practical recommendations.

This is an on-site position based in Richmond, California, offering the opportunity to work directly with a growing food business across retail and food-service channels. The role is well suited for someone who enjoys managing multiple projects, working collaboratively, and combining analytical thinking with strong communication and marketing execution skills.

Marketing

Support the development and execution of product-family strategies for retail and food-service products, including brand positioning, messaging, and recommendations that address customer and consumer needs.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

Your Career

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager focused on AI Security, you will define how the market understands and adopts security for the next generation of AI systems. AI is no longer just generating content, it is making decisions and taking action. As enterprises move from AI assistance to AI autonomy, the risk shifts from what AI says to what AI does. Your role will be instrumental in shaping how organizations secure this transition. You will drive messaging and marketing strategy across critical layers of AI systems, including models, artifacts, access and control layers, and agentic execution helping customers safely deploy AI at scale. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product management, sales, PR, social, and field marketing, across multiple business units to craft and execute narratives that resonate with both technical practitioners and business leaders. About The Role

Proving the return on AI spend is one of the biggest business transformations in tech history, and CloudZero has repositioned the entire company to solve it. The catch is that nearly every vendor now claims to do the same thing, so differentiation is our top marketing priority for the next 18 months, and it's what decides whether a buyer picks us or someone who just sounds like us. We're adding this role to go all-in on differentiation, and to add more firepower to everything the PMM team already does today.

The Senior Product Marketing Manager will own and drive continuous progress on the core messaging and differentiation of our platform. You'll make it clear and undeniable why CloudZero is the right choice for a buyer with a specific problem, translate a technical product into the "so what" for finance and executive buyers, and build on our market research and competitive intelligence to stay ahead as the field gets more crowded.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role that supplements our existing team. We're looking for an exceptional marketer who can own the positioning of a category while it's still being defined, and who'd rather develop and continuously sharpen the story than wait for someone to hand it over.

What You'll Do

Messaging & differentiation

Own the core messaging and differentiation of our platform, the clear and undeniable reason a buyer with a specific problem should choose CloudZero over every other vendor claiming AI ROI
Translate what product and engineering build into clear buyer value for finance and executive audiences, simple enough that a rep in their first month can tell the story with confidence
Work across product and engineering, demand generation, and sales enablement to keep messaging consistent across our core content assets

Competitive intelligence & market research

Own competitive intelligence by tracking the field, arming sales with battlecards and objection handling, and sharpening our positioning against every alternative.
Run market and buyer research to keep our messaging matched to where the industry and the buyer are heading
Stay ahead of other vendors in an increasingly crowded market, and feed those insights back into our positioning and roadmap decisions

Cross-functional enablement & funnel support

Support product launches and make sure new capabilities land in our core positioning, backed by strong proof points and real customer examples
Work alongside content and demand generation to feed the top of the funnel with differentiated stories that create demand, not just capture it
Partner with sales engineering to define the capabilities and narratives that make every demo prove the CloudZero difference and move buyers to a proof of value

What We're Looking For

5-8 years in product marketing for a technical B2B product, ideally at a startup or in a fast-moving category
A track record of sharp messaging and differentiation in a crowded or emerging market
Proven ability to translate complex, technical products into clear buyer value; you can make even a junior rep sound credible
Proven experience and expertise in running market research and competitive intelligence programs
Experience marketing to finance and technical executives (CFOs, CTOs, or AI and business-transformation leaders) and their teams, ideally from a B2B tech or fintech company; a security or other technical, skeptical-audience background is a plus
Genuine curiosity: you want to be in the product, talking to customers, and learning what your audience actually cares about, without being asked (a journalistic or reporting background is a plus)
The judgment to pull context from many sources, extract what matters, and run with it, rather than waiting to be handed the answer
An AI-first operator who uses tools like Claude to move faster, learn a domain quickly, and scale your own output

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

CloudZero wins new logos when a buyer can say, in one sentence, why us and not the alternatives. This role owns that sentence and the proof behind it. You'll set the messaging, sharpen the differentiation, and give sales and content the story that turns a crowded, skeptical market into pipeline. We hire for the exceptional version of this role: curious, decisive, high-bar, low-ego, with the room to own it.

CloudZero is the AI ROI Company. We built the financial control plane for AI: the system finance, IT, and engineering use to connect every AI dollar to the outcome it produced. Across every provider. In real time.

AI spend is the fastest-growing line on enterprise P&Ls and the least understood. Only 14% of CFOs can prove AI ROI today. CloudZero answers the question no one else can: what did it cost to produce this outcome, for this customer, on this model.

The largest cloud spenders on the planet already run on CloudZero, including Coinbase, Duolingo, DoorDash, and Shutterstock. We processed 14 trillion billing events in the last twelve months. We're the first listed partner on Anthropic's cost and usage API. We've raised over $119 million, including a $56 million Series C backed by leading venture capital firms.

Why Join Our Team?

At CloudZero, you’ll find a collaborative, fast-moving environment where your work makes a direct impact. We’re a team that values ownership, creativity, and curiosity — and we’re tackling some of the most complex challenges in the cloud space. If you’re excited by working with cutting-edge technology, driving meaningful outcomes, and growing with a company that’s scaling fast, we’d love to hear from you!

The ideal candidate understands how to create compelling outbound marketing in a space where the most important proof points are often under NDA — and can translate Marvell's platform differentiation across advanced SerDes, custom HBM, die-to-die interconnects, silicon photonics, and advanced packaging into credible, market-facing thought leadership.

Product Marketing & Outbound Strategy

Own the full outbound marketing strategy for Marvell's custom silicon portfolio — including custom XPUs, XPU attach solutions (NICs, CXL controllers, PCIe retimers, co-processors), and the advanced technology platform that enables Marvell's hyperscaler co-design partnerships — building Marvell's market leadership narrative while navigating the unique challenge of driving awareness in a business defined by confidential customer relationships.
Define and maintain differentiated value propositions and messaging hierarchies for each portfolio segment; ensure consistent, compelling communication of Marvell's competitive advantages to external audiences.
Lead product launch planning and execution, driving cross-functional readiness across sales, PR, analyst relations, digital, and events to maximize market impact at launch.
Develop competitive response playbooks and sales enablement content — including pitch decks, solution briefs, battle cards, and objection-handling guides — that equip customer-facing teams to win.
Partner with product management and engineering teams to deeply understand technology roadmaps; translate product capabilities into external marketing strategies, not internal product plans.

Technology Marketing & Thought Leadership

Build and execute a technology marketing strategy that establishes Marvell as the recognized leader in custom cloud silicon — spanning custom XPUs, XPU attach, and the advanced IP platform that enables next-generation AI accelerators — translating deep technical differentiation into market-defining narratives that build Marvell's leadership position with hyperscalers, emerging cloud operators, and the broader AI infrastructure ecosystem, while respecting the confidentiality requirements inherent to co-design partnerships.
Create a pipeline of compelling thought leadership assets including white papers, solution briefs, executive presentations, keynote narratives, and technical blogs that translate silicon-level innovation into customer and industry impact.
Partner with executive and product leadership to develop and sharpen Marvell's technology narrative for major industry forums, analyst briefings, customer events, and investor communications.
Act as a senior voice of the market — tracking industry trends, competitive dynamics, and customer requirements to continuously sharpen Marvell's positioning.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Organizational Influence

Serve as the primary outbound marketing partner to product line executives and product management teams — translating roadmap inputs into external marketing strategies, audience narratives, and campaign execution.
Collaborate across marketing functions — corporate, digital, events, AR/PR, and content — to ensure portfolio messaging is consistently amplified across all channels and touchpoints.
Establish shared messaging frameworks, launch standards, and audience segmentation playbooks that scale across Marvell's business units and marketing organization.
Represent the marketing function in senior leadership forums, ensuring outbound marketing strategy and investment priorities are informed by market insight and tied to business outcomes.

What We're Looking For

BS degree required; a degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline is highly preferred. MBA or MS in a business or quantitative discipline valued in addition to an engineering foundation.
15+ years of progressive experience in outbound product marketing or technology marketing within the semiconductor, systems, or AI infrastructure industry — candidates with pure product management backgrounds will not be considered.
Deep expertise in custom silicon and AI accelerator markets — including custom ASIC/XPU design, XPU attach solutions, and hyperscaler infrastructure — with demonstrated understanding of the hyperscaler buyer landscape, co-design partnership dynamics, and the competitive and technology trends shaping next-generation custom AI compute.
Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-product outbound marketing programs — from audience strategy and positioning through campaign execution — with measurable business results.
Exceptional ability to synthesize highly technical concepts into external audience narratives, customer value stories, and industry thought leadership that drives awareness and preference.
Proven experience developing and activating marketing content across the full outbound mix: executive presentations, white papers, solution briefs, digital campaigns, event activations, and media/analyst engagement.
Strong cross-functional influence skills — able to collaborate effectively with product management without conflating the two disciplines; clear understanding of where marketing responsibility begins and ends.
Strong executive presence and communication skills — confident presenting to partners, at industry conferences, and in internal leadership settings.
Experience building and leading teams; strong track record recruiting, developing, and retaining top marketing talent.

Preferred

Experience working with or marketing to hyperscalers and cloud service providers in the context of custom silicon co-design programs — with a demonstrated ability to build compelling outbound narratives while navigating customer confidentiality requirements.
Familiarity with custom ASIC program dynamics, advanced packaging technologies (2.5D/3D, RDL interposers), and the multi-generational partnership models that define hyperscaler custom silicon engagements.
Track record of building or scaling a product marketing function; prior people management experience a strong plus.
Track record of building or scaling a product marketing function in a business where key proof points are under NDA; experience developing credible thought leadership in a confidential co-development environment strongly preferred.

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)

199,090 - 298,200, $ per annum

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights include an employee stock purchase plan with a 2-year look back, family support programs to help balance work and home life, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and a recognition and service awards to celebrate contributions and milestones. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

Strong experience building event-driven customer journeys using behavioral triggers, customer data, audience segmentation, and multi-channel automations.

WellnessLiving is a business management software platform that helps health, wellness, and beauty businesses across North America grow and thrive. We're looking for a creative, curious person who loves working with AI. In this role, you'll use AI tools like Claude to create marketing content and build marketing automations for the WellnessLiving brand. You'll spend most of your day working side by side with AI. You'll tell it what to do, check its work, make it better, and turn great ideas into real results.

This isn't a coding job. It's a job for someone who can think clearly, write well, and knows a great piece of marketing when they see it.

What You'll Do

Build and manage automated email and SMS campaigns that reach the right people at the right time
Use AI to create engaging social media posts for WellnessLiving
Use AI to write and improve website pages and blog posts
Write clear instructions (prompts) that help AI create high quality work
Review everything AI creates and make sure it's on brand, accurate, and ready to go
Follow step by step guidance from AI tools to set up and test new workflows
Work closely with the marketing team to turn ideas into finished campaigns
Keep testing and learning new ways to use AI to save time and get better results

What Will Make You Successful

We believe these five qualities matter most in this role:

You're creative. You bring fresh ideas and you're not afraid to try new things.
You know what good looks like. You can spot strong writing and design, and you can tell when something isn't quite right yet.
You can instruct AI well. You give clear, detailed directions and you know how to get the best out of AI tools.
You ask great questions. You dig in to understand the goal before you start, and you're not shy about asking for help.
You can follow instructions and stay patient. AI often guides you step by step. You follow along carefully, and you stay calm and keep going when something takes a few tries to get right.

What You Bring

2+ years of experience in marketing, content, or communications
Excellent writing skills. You can write in a clear, friendly, and engaging way.
Hands on experience using AI tools in your work
Experience with email, SMS, social media, or website content
Strong attention to detail
Comfort learning new software quickly
Bonus: experience in the health, wellness, or beauty industry

This Role Might Not Be For You If

You'd rather do everything yourself than work with AI
You get frustrated when something takes a few tries to get right
You prefer to be told exactly what to do instead of asking questions and figuring things out
You're happy with "good enough" instead of excellent

What We Offer

Health benefits
A hybrid schedule with 3 days a week in our Delray Beach office
A chance to be at the front of how AI is changing marketing
A supportive team that loves to learn and try new things

How To Apply

Send us your resume along with a short AI task:

Use AI to create a 5-email drip campaign aimed at yoga studio owners, inviting them to book a demo of WellnessLiving software. Along with the 5 emails, share your first prompt and every follow-up prompt you used to build and improve the sequence.

We want to see how you think, how you guide AI, and how you make the final result excellent. We can't wait to see what you create!

jobs.description:
Overview

Azure Customer Success Marketing
helps customers get more value from the cloud investment they have already made. Our team owns the authoritative guidance Microsoft publishes for building and running on Azure, including the Cloud Adoption Framework, the Well-Architected Framework, and the Azure Architecture Center, along with the programs that put that guidance in front of the engineers and architects who need it.

We are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager
to own how that guidance reaches its audience. You will build the layer that sits above the source material: the ebooks, technical papers, blogs, and video programming that take guidance spread across dozens of articles and turn it into something a practitioner can follow end to end. You will also host and produce our flagship Azure technical video series, a catalog of more than 220 episodes reaching developers, IT decision makers, and business decision makers. This role asks you to be genuinely technical and genuinely a marketer. You will write deep technical content yourself, working alongside subject matter experts rather than briefing them from a distance, and you will hold your own in architecture conversations with cloud solution architects, product teams, and engineering leaders. You will also own the campaign mechanics that carry the work: channel strategy, integrated marketing, measurement, and the vendor and production partners who help you scale. The portfolio is active and growing. A multi-part technical masterclass series is in production, the video show is moving to a fully produced format, and in-product and agent-driven guidance experiences are being built with engineering. You will inherit momentum and be expected to shape where it goes next.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Own the marketing strategy for Microsoft's authoritative Azure guidance, turning framework content into material that engineers and architects can act on.

jobs.title: SVP, Global Marketing

The Senior Vice President of Marketing
is a modern, culturally connected, and commercially minded leader responsible for shaping how our brand shows up in the world and accelerating its next chapter of growth. This leader will be responsible for building desire, relevance, and distinction for the brand globally connecting brand strategy, culture, creativity, content, media, consumer engagement, and commercial activation into one powerful marketing ecosystem, while owning the full marketing P&L.

This leader understands that modern brands are built through a continuous combination of storytelling, creators, communities, cultural moments, experiences, partnerships, social platforms, earned media, retail, and increasingly personalized consumer relationships.

The ideal candidate understands both the enduring principles of brand building and the rapidly changing ways consumers discover, experience, talk about, and ultimately choose brands.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Build Global Brand Desire

Define and continuously evolve the global brand strategy, positioning, and narrative.
Translate the brand’s purpose and positioning into distinctive stories, experiences, and expressions that create emotional connection and long-term desirability, rooted in a human truth.
Ensure the brand has a recognizable point of view, visual identity, tone of voice, and cultural presence across markets and consumer touchpoints.
Balance the discipline of long-term brand building with the speed and experimentation required by today’s media environment.

Position the Brand in Culture

Move the brand from simply communicating campaigns to participating meaningfully in culture.
Identify the cultural conversations, communities, personalities, partnerships, and moments where the brand has permission to participate.
Build relationships with creators, tastemakers, ambassadors, and cultural institutions capable of extending the brand’s relevance and reach.

Reinvent Content & Storytelling

Build a modern global content engine capable of producing culturally relevant content at the speed consumers expect.
Develop a clear ecosystem for hero storytelling, social-first content, creator content, product storytelling, editorial content, and real-time cultural activation.
Move beyond a campaign-centric marketing calendar toward an always-on storytelling model.
Ensure creative ideas can travel across platforms while respecting the different behaviors, formats, and communities of each channel.
Champion experimentation with emerging creative technologies, including generative AI, while maintaining high standards of creativity, originality, and brand integrity.

Lead the New Media Ecosystem

Develop an integrated approach across paid, owned, earned, shared, and creator media.
Continuously evolve the global media mix as consumer attention shifts across platforms.
Build media strategies around attention and influence, not simply impressions.
Develop strong partnerships with the world’s most relevant platforms, publishers, creators, and media partners.

Build Creator & Community Marketing as a Core Capability

Develop a sophisticated global creator strategy that extends far beyond traditional influencer marketing.
Understand how advocacy, user-generated content, social conversation, and community can become meaningful drivers of brand equity and acquisition.

Connect Brand and Commerce

Ensure marketing ultimately contributes to sustainable business growth.
Partner closely with product, merchandising, retail, e-commerce, and regional teams to connect global brand storytelling with product launches and commercial priorities.
Build stronger connections between storytelling and conversion across digital commerce, stores, and wholesale environments.
Treat stores and physical experiences as important brand media, not simply points of distribution.

Build Consumer Intelligence

Make consumer understanding a competitive advantage.
Combine traditional research with social listening, search behavior, cultural intelligence, community insights, CRM data, and behavioral signals to understand how consumers and culture are changing.
Translate insights into clear decisions about audiences, products, communication, and experiences.
Create an organization that is curious about consumers rather than dependent solely on periodic research presentations.

Create a Modern Measurement Model

Build a measurement framework that balances brand health, cultural relevance, consumer engagement, and commercial performance.
Move the organization beyond simplistic measures such as impressions, clicks, and last-touch attribution.

Lead a Global Marketing Organization

Build, inspire, and develop a world-class global marketing organization.
Create a culture that combines creative ambition, consumer obsession, commercial accountability, curiosity, and speed.
Clarify the respective roles of global and regional marketing teams while allowing markets enough flexibility to remain culturally relevant.
Attract a new generation of marketing talent across brand, social, content, creators, media, consumer insights, and emerging capabilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Marketing Leader:
12+ years of senior marketing leadership experience, ideally within a premium/lifestyle, travel, fashion, or consumer goods brand with global scale.
Modernizer:
Demonstrated track record of modernizing a marketing organization—shifting from traditional brand marketing toward creator-, social-, and data-led approaches while preserving premium brand positioning.
Platform Fluency:
Fluency in the current media and platform landscape, including the creator economy, short-form video, social commerce, retail media networks, AI-driven personalization, and community-led growth.
Global Scale:
Experience building and scaling global campaigns that flex locally, working across regional teams and agency partners, and building and managing both in-house and external creative resources.
Business Driver:
Strong commercial instincts, with experience owning a marketing P&L and connecting brand investment to measurable growth outcomes.
Personal Leadership:
Collaborative and curious leadership style, energized by culture, emerging platforms, and shifts in consumer behavior. Experience leading and developing high-performing creative, PR, digital, and marketing teams.
Influence:
Ability to communicate effectively, build relationships, and influence at all levels of the organization.

Renesas is seeking an AI Search & SEO Specialist
to help improve how engineers discover, evaluate, and engage with Renesas content across AI-powered answer engines, traditional organic search, and onsite search experiences.

In this role, you’ll report to the Manager, Content Strategy & AI Visibility and work closely with content, web, product, technical, and analytics teams to monitor performance, identify trends, surface opportunities, and recommend improvements across Renesas.com. You’ll help shape how we evaluate search performance across both traditional and AI-driven environments, by identifying optimization opportunities that improve visibility and discoverability for our products and solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Improve how Renesas appears in AI-generated answers and emerging search experiences by identifying trends, opportunities, and areas for optimization across content.
Establish and socialize AI search, generative engine optimization (GEO) and SEO best practices, enabling content owners, marketers, web producers, developers, and regional teams to create content that is accurate, discoverable, structured, and aligned with how customers search and evaluate.
Build and maintain recurring reporting for search visibility, traffic, engagement, and conversion performance using tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, SEMrush, Conductor, onsite search analytics, and emerging AI visibility platforms.
Analyze onsite search behavior to identify customer intent, content gaps, terminology mismatches, and relevance issues, then partner with product and web teams to improve search experiences through tuning, taxonomy, synonyms, facets, rules, and AI-informed content recommendations.
Work closely with the technical web team to identify and prioritize technical improvements that help search engines and AI systems better interpret, index, and surface Renesas content.
Support business reviews and stakeholder presentations by preparing performance summaries, visualizations, and insight narratives.
Stay current on search and digital marketing trends to help inform future optimization opportunities, reporting needs, and measurement approaches.

Qualifications
