jobs.title: Part-Time Marketing Strategist & Growth Partner
jobs.description:
Part-Time Marketing Strategist & Growth Partner

Company: The Blue Sock
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Independent Contractor
Engagement: Part-time, ongoing

About The Blue Sock

The Blue Sock is an early-stage, Southern California-based boutique dog-sitting marketplace connecting pet parents with a curated community of experienced, independent sitters.

Unlike traditional pet-sitting marketplaces, we emphasize quality, transparency, and personalized care. Our platform helps pet parents discover and compare sitters based on their care styles, home environments, specialties, and unique experiences.

We’ve successfully launched our website and app, established a growing customer base, and are generating bookings and repeat business.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we’re seeking an experienced marketing professional to help us develop a sustainable, data-driven marketing strategy.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a part-time Marketing Strategist & Growth Partner who can evaluate our current marketing efforts, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop a clear, actionable growth roadmap.

This is a strategic and hands-on consulting opportunity designed for someone who enjoys working directly with founders and helping early-stage businesses grow.

Our philosophy is simple: Identify the highest-impact opportunities, execute one priority at a time, measure results, and build on what’s working.

We’re not looking to implement every marketing initiative simultaneously. We want to make thoughtful investments that deliver measurable business value while staying within our available resources.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct an initial assessment of our existing marketing strategy, acquisition channels, website, customer journey, and competitive positioning.
* Develop a prioritized marketing roadmap with actionable recommendations, measurable goals, and clear deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, booking conversion rates, customer retention, and revenue growth.
* Evaluate geographic marketing opportunities as our two-sided marketplace expands.
* Review our existing Google Ads strategy and collaborate with our advertising specialist on potential improvements.
* Recommend and help implement focused marketing initiatives, one priority at a time.
* Establish meaningful performance metrics and evaluate results to guide future priorities.
* Collaborate directly with our founder to refine the strategy as our business evolves.

Potential initiatives may include conversion rate optimization, SEO, local marketing, customer retention campaigns, email marketing, referral programs, brand positioning, and paid advertising strategy.

The exact priorities will be determined through the initial assessment.

Ideal Candidate

We’re looking for someone who brings both strategic thinking and practical execution experience.

Preferred qualifications:

* Proven experience developing and executing growth strategies for startups or early-stage businesses.
* Experience with online marketplaces, two-sided platforms, booking platforms, or consumer-facing service businesses.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and retention.
* Ability to analyze marketing performance and connect recommendations to measurable business outcomes.
* Experience developing actionable growth roadmaps and prioritizing initiatives based on expected impact, cost, and effort.
* Comfortable providing hands-on execution rather than exclusively strategic recommendations.
* Resourceful, proactive, and comfortable working within a modest startup budget.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working directly with founders.

Experience in the pet care industry is welcome but not required.

How We’ll Work Together

Our initial engagement will focus on understanding the business, evaluating existing marketing efforts, and identifying the highest-value growth opportunities.

From there, we’ll work collaboratively on a prioritized roadmap.

Rather than tackling numerous initiatives simultaneously, we’ll select a manageable priority, agree on the deliverables, implement improvements, evaluate the results, and determine our next steps.

We currently have a dedicated Google Ads specialist managing day-to-day campaign activity. We welcome strategic oversight and recommendations, but we’re not necessarily looking to duplicate existing campaign management responsibilities.

Our goal is to develop a long-term partnership with someone who can grow alongside the business.

Compensation & Engagement

* Starting monthly consulting budget: $800
* Part-time, remote, independent contractor engagement.
* Limited monthly scope with mutually agreed deliverables.
* Flexible working arrangement focused on outcomes rather than a traditional employment schedule.
* Opportunity for increased compensation and expanded responsibilities as the business grows.

Our $800 monthly budget is a starting point, reflecting our current stage as an early-stage marketplace.

We’re looking to build a long-term relationship with a marketing professional whose work contributes to measurable improvements in customer acquisition, booking conversions, retention, and platform revenue.

As our business grows and marketing initiatives demonstrate a positive impact, our intention is to reinvest in marketing and gradually increase the budget and scope of the engagement.

Future increases will depend on demonstrated results, sustainable business growth, and available resources rather than a predetermined timeline.

We recognize that some marketing initiatives take time to deliver measurable financial returns, and we value thoughtful strategy, effective execution, and consistent progress.

Individual Consultants Only

We’re a small team and prefer to collaborate directly with one dedicated marketing professional.

We are not seeking marketing agencies, outsourced teams, or arrangements where work is routinely delegated to other individuals.

We value direct communication, continuity, accountability, and a partner who takes the time to understand our business.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role isn’t measured solely by website traffic, impressions, or social media engagement.

We’re focused on meaningful business outcomes, including improved booking conversion rates, more qualified customer acquisition, stronger retention, and sustainable growth in platform revenue.

We’re seeking someone who can help us make informed marketing decisions and gradually build a stronger foundation for long-term growth.

If you enjoy partnering with early-stage companies, identifying practical growth opportunities, and turning strategy into measurable results, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description:

Role Overview

The Director, Performance Marketing will lead Cboe’s paid media strategy and demand generation across our core lines of businesses. This role owns the paid media engine that builds awareness, generates qualified engagement, and accelerates pipeline for Cboe’s product lines. You will lead full-funnel media strategy, partnering closely with sales, product marketing, and regional teams to translate media investment into measurable commercial impact.

Your responsibilities will be:

Paid Media Strategy & Ownership

Own the paid media strategy, budget allocation, and channel mix across search, paid social, programmatic, and emerging platforms for Cboe’s core business lines
Set and defend the paid media budget with senior leadership, including scenario planning and tiered spend recommendations by business line
Own the paid media agency relationship end-to-end — scope, performance targets, creative and media plan approval, and spend accountability
Build and prioritize a paid testing roadmap spanning channels, audiences, offers, and creative formats

Growth Strategy & Planning

Define the broader growth marketing strategy across acquisition, activation, and expansion, with paid as the primary lever and lifecycle/owned channels as reinforcement
Partner with Business Line leaders to translate commercial priorities into paid media and growth objectives and KPIs

Full-Funnel Program Ownership

Ensure paid campaigns are backed by strong conversion paths, working closely with Performance Marketing Analytics to instrument tracking, attribution, and message match across landing experiences
Extend paid programs into lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with the Marketing Automation & Email team (Pardot/Cvent) Cross-Functional Leadership Serve as the connective tissue between Performance Marketing, Content Strategy, Web/CMS, and Sales to ensure paid investment is coordinated end-to-end
Represent paid media and growth performance in executive and all-hands settings, translating spend and results into clear business narratives
Manage relationships with paid media and growth-focused agencies and vendors, including scope, budget, and performance accountability

Team & Org Building

Build and manage a growth marketing team

Measurement & Optimization

Establish growth marketing dashboards and reporting cadences in partnership with analytics lead, with clear visibility into CAC, conversion rates, pipeline contribution, and ROI.
Continuously test and optimize campaigns using a rigorous, hypothesis-driven approach

The ideal candidate has:

10+ years of marketing experience with at least 5 years focused on paid media / performance marketing, including 3+ years in a leadership role
Deep expertise across B2B paid channels – paid search, programmatic, LinkedIn, and financial / trade publications – with hands-on fluency in platform capabilities, bidding strategies, and creative best practices
Experience planning and executing brand media campaigns, including out-of-home (traditional and digital OOH), with an understanding of brand measurement approaches
Proven ability to build integrated brand and demand programs and demonstrate media’s influence on pipeline in complex, long-cycle B2B env
Experience marketing to institutional financial audiences; experience marketing to retail customers a plus
Strong analytical skills – comfort with attribution models and media mix modeling concepts
Experience managing media budgets and holding agencies accountable to performance targets
Bachelor's degree required; MBA or relevant advanced degree a plus

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

Samsung Electronics America (SEA) is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. Across each of these areas, our work drives innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity in the United States.

For nearly five decades, Samsung has been at the forefront of technological advancements, investing over $100 billion and creating more than 20,000 jobs nationwide. Our mission? To integrate cutting-edge products, services, and AI technology to deliver smarter, sustainable, and more connected experiences that empower people to live better.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SEA offers opportunities to work alongside global visionary thinkers and innovators who are passionate about making a difference. Explore the exciting opportunities at Samsung Electronics America and discover how you can make an impact.

To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

Role And Responsibilities

The Samsung Home Entertainment (HE) Division is seeking a visionary, highly strategic and results-driven Director of Paid Media to lead the holistic paid media ecosystem across national, retail, and performance channels. This leader will build and execute integrated strategies that connect Samsung Home Entertainment to its consumers and shoppers – maximizing efficiency, performance, and brand equity across every stage of the funnel.

This role reports to the Director of GTM & Campaigns, is based in Plano, TX, and follows Samsung's onsite work model, with 5% travel expected to support retail partners, agencies, and cross-functional teams.

Overall Responsibilities

Lead the Paid Media team, driving strategy, planning, measurement, and reporting.
Develop a holistic paid media strategy across National, Retail, and Performance Media to maximize sales nationally, at strategic retail partners, and at Samsung.com.
Collaborate with Executive Leadership, Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, Global Marketing and other stakeholders.
Leverage advanced measurement tools, including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), and media analytics to maximize incremental ROAS and optimize media in real time.

National Media Responsibilities

Media Strategy and Planning:

Develop and oversee the fully integrated, national paid media strategies aligned with the HE Division’s business objectives, national sales goals, and brand health goals.
Identify and reach target audiences, leveraging first-party and partner data to optimize campaigns.
Test innovative approaches to engage consumers and oversee budget allocation across channels.
Collaborate with the marketing and product teams to ensure paid media campaigns align with product launches, promotions, and seasonal events.

Channel Management:

Oversee paid media campaigns across all channels, including traditional Linear, CTV/OTT, OLV, Display (Programmatic and Direct), DOOH, Social, Search, and Retail Media (e.g., Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Best Buy Ads, etc.).
Stay up to date on emerging media channels and technologies (e.g., AI-driven media buying, retail media networks, and influencer/creator media) and identify innovative ways to reach our consumers more effectively.

Campaign Planning & Optimization:

Plan and execute national paid media campaigns, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to brand guidelines.
Optimize campaigns based on performance data, adjusting targeting, creatives, and bidding strategies to improve results.
Design and conduct in-market tests to identify the most effective campaign elements.

Retail Media Responsibilities

Retail Media Strategy Development:

Develop comprehensive strategy aligning retail media efforts with national and performance media.
Integrate retail media into holistic media planning, making media budget allocation recommendations to maximize national sales while simultaneously growing all accounts.
Ensure retail media efforts are synched with in-store marketing strategies to create a seamless shopping experience.
Deliver account-specific strategic and executional guidance for each account marketing team to execute to maximize profitable sales at each retailer.

Performance Media Responsibilities

Performance Media Strategy Development:

Develop strategies to maximize qualified traffic and sales on Samsung.com.
Oversee campaigns across Paid Search (SEM, PMax, PLA, etc.), Social, Display, and affiliate marketing.
Leverage advanced data capabilities to target high-propensity audiences and maximize conversion.

Campaign Planning & Optimization:

Optimize campaigns based on performance data.
Collaborate with Ecomm and Corporate Marketing teams to align on Samsung.com performance targets.
Continuously test creative, bidding, and audience strategies to identify scalable improvements in efficiency and ROAS.

Media Analytics & Measurement Responsibilities

Regularly report on key paid media performance metrics to division leadership and to relevant cross-functional stakeholders.
Collaborate on advanced analytics such as Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), leveraging learnings from each to inform investment decisions and optimize media in real-time.
Work with the ecomm team to report on key performance marketing results and recommend optimizations.

General Responsibilities

Create, manage, and optimize media budgets, allocating spend across national, retail, and performance marketing to maximize sales.
Build and manage relationships with the lead media agency and external vendors; evaluating agencies based on expertise, performance, and cost-effectiveness.
Establish KPIs aligned to business objectives and continuously measure campaign performance.
Oversee the MMM, MTA, and advanced analytics tools to track campaign performance, inform budget allocation decisions, optimize performance, and report to the business.
Monitor and analyze competitors' strategies to ensure plans will cut through in market.
Follow internal practices for finance, regulatory compliance, data security, privacy in all operations.
Mitigate risks associated with ad fraud, brand safety, and data privacy.

Skills And Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

12+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 10 years with an advanced (Masters/PhD) degree.
Expertise in media management, and campaign management.
Experience leading and leveraging advanced modeling techniques such as MMM and MTA.
Strong communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office tools.
Data-driven approach to decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in consumer electronics, durable goods, or technology hardware categories.
Proven track record managing complex, multi-agency relationships and enterprise-level media budgets.
Hands-on proficiency with platforms such as DV360, CM360, The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, and retail media networks (e.g., Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Best Buy Ads).
Prior people-management experience building, mentoring, and developing high-performing media teams.
MBA or other advanced degree.

jobs.description:
Location:
Cambridge, MA / Hybrid

(This role requires working in-office 3 days per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.)

About us:

EverQuote is a leading AI-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share.

Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real-world impact and do the best work of your career, you’ve found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you.

About the role:

As Senior Analyst, Paid Media, you will own television, connected TV, streaming video, YouTube, and streaming audio for EverQuote’s consumer growth businesses. These are new and fast-growing channels for us, and you will be the single owner: planning, buying, optimizing, and proving out what works.

You will report to the Manager, Paid Media, and work closely with Data Science, Marketing, and Finance. This is a high-ownership role with significant budget and no existing playbook. We are looking for a hands-on video and audio buyer and a strong analyst who can show leadership where the channel works and how to scale it.

What you’ll do:

Own end-to-end planning, buying, and optimization of CTV, streaming video, YouTube, linear TV, and streaming audio campaigns.
Manage budgets, flighting, and pacing against monthly and quarterly targets; forecast spend and flag risk early.

HotSchedules is the restaurant industry’s most widely used scheduling platform. Over 300,000 restaurants across North America trust HotSchedules. The SMB team is at the top of our growth funnel—introducing restaurant operators to HotSchedules.
As the dedicated demand gen marketer for SMB, you’ll own the pipeline programs that fuel bookings for two high-performing sales teams. Running both inbound programs and outbound sales-led campaigns to hit quarterly bookings targets.
Some of this GTM motion exists and needs refinement. Some of it you’ll create from scratch. You'll pull in Product Marketing, Sales, and RevOps when you need them — but you won't wait for alignment to move. You drive the work and bring people along.
The challenge in marketing today, the channels are crowded. The job is to find where there’s still signal, test aggressively, and scale what works. Plus, cutting what doesn’t work before it becomes a habit. That means bringing new ideas, tinkering with tools, and being willing to experiment your way to an answer. It also means knowing your customer deeply enough that your messaging cuts through. Understanding what operators care about, where they spend their time, and what makes them stop and listen.

Primary Responsibilities

Own pipeline:
Drive inbound and outbound demand programs end-to-end — strategy, execution, iteration — with a clear line to SAO targets each quarter. Pipeline and bookings are how we keep score.

Embed with sales:
Standups, call shadows, deal reviews. Short deal cycles mean fast feedback loops — you’ll know quickly what’s working and can act on it fast.

Build campaigns that earn attention:
Develop integrated, multi-touch programs across email, paid, content, and outbound that speak to operators’ reality.

Know your buyer:
Learn from regular operator interviews and sales calls to craft messaging, creative, and campaign strategy that works.

Build and evolve the stack:
Identify gaps, propose solutions, implement what works. You don’t wait for a better workflow — you build it.

Use AI to scale yourself:
Tools, workflows, agents. Use technology extends your capabilities and gain leverage.

Close the loop:
Partner with RevOps on scoring, routing, response times, and reporting.

Key Skills And Competencies

5–7 years in B2B demand generation, ideally SaaS, with a track record of owning a pipeline number.
Fluent across channels: email, paid, content, events, outbound. Good enough at all of them to know which one to reach for and to connect them into programs that convert.
A strong writer who can speak to a small business owner’s daily reality.
Someone who embeds with sales rather than operating at arm’s length. Low ego, high output.
A tinkerer. You’ve built workflows, tested tools, played with agents — and you have real examples to show for it.
Comfortable being accountable. You track pipeline/ SAO targets like it's your own money. When the pipeline is short, you figure out why and fix it.
You've pulled your own pipeline and conversion data, found the problem before someone told you about it, and changed your program because of what you saw.
You've killed your own programs when the data said so — even ones you built and liked.
A curious, life-long learner

Why This Role

Restaurant operators run some of the hardest businesses in the world. When HotSchedules works, it makes their lives meaningfully easier. This role puts you at the front of that pipeline—it's how you get there, but the operator on the other end is why it matters.

What We Do

First American Trust is seeking an experienced a Senior Marketing Specialist to join our team. The position will cover a broad spectrum of marketing responsibilities; and have responsibility over various functions listed below. In addition, these specialties may deliver content & communications via a variety of methods such as digital, print and publication etc.

Direct Marketing/Advertising/Promotional

What You'll Do:

Direct marketing involves sending promotional marketing materials directly to consumers (print and publication).

Product/Brand Marketing

Product/Brand marketing is the focus area devoted to strategically bringing a new product or service to market. This discipline sets the strategy, guiding many of the other marketing specializations listed. Much of their work is based on research to understand the important variables related to competitors’ products, review and synthesize consumer research information and meet with product development teams to better understand the features of the product. This information is then used to formulate an overall product marketing strategy.

Content Marketing

Content marketing is all about creating content—basically any consumable piece of information—that serves a purpose beyond just promoting a product. Content marketing can build positive sentiment for a brand by attaching the brand to something genuinely helpful or entertaining.

Social Media Marketing

The purpose of social media marketing is generally to drive traffic to a company’s website while boosting overall brand awareness and customer loyalty. Marketers achieve this by using a variety of methods on various social media platforms, from Facebook to Snapchat and everything in between. Social media gives brands and businesses the opportunity to interact with the public in a personalized way.

Database Marketing

Database marketers collect information about consumer preferences to create targeted messages to consumers.

Marketing Research & Analysis

Market researchers employ several tactics for picking the brains of the public and gathering information and interpreting the data.

Experience developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital, social media, direct marketing, and content channels

The Sr. Director, Product & Technology Marketing for the Data Center Networking Business Group will own the outbound marketing strategy for Marvell's photonic fabric, co-packaged optics (CPO), optical connectivity, data center switching, and data center interconnect (DCI) portfolio. This is a high-stakes, system-level marketing role — the target audience is not component buyers, but platform decision-makers: system architects at hyperscalers and data center operators who are making infrastructure-level choices about how to scale AI clusters beyond the rack. The marketing challenge is translating silicon-level photonic innovation into a compelling end-to-end narrative about the future of AI-scale connectivity — from millimeters between chips on a co-packaged optics module, to photonic fabric and high-radix switching connecting XPU to XPU within the cluster, to coherent DCI solutions spanning kilometers between data centers.

Product Marketing & Outbound Strategy

Own the full outbound marketing strategy for Marvell's Optical & Data Center Systems portfolio — amplifying Marvell's market-leading connectivity position across photonic fabric, CPO, data center switching, and coherent DCI — through differentiated positioning, compelling messaging, and targeted channel activation that drives awareness and preference with hyperscaler and data center operator audiences.

Partner with product management and engineering teams to deeply understand technology roadmaps; translate product capabilities into external marketing strategies, not internal product plans.

Technology Marketing & Thought Leadership

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe water is more than a resource, it's a shared responsibility. As part of our Water Business Group, you’ll help shape how communities manage water for generations to come. From delivering safe drinking water and treating wastewater responsibly to developing sustainable water supplies and protecting lives and property through flood control, your work will directly support public health, environmental sustainability, and infrastructure resilience. We bring together experts across disciplines to solve complex challenges with bold thinking and technical excellence. Whether you're modernizing aging systems or pioneering innovative approaches, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. This isn’t just a job, it's a chance to lead change, drive progress, and leave a lasting legacy.

Join a team that’s shaping the future of water infrastructure in Northern California. As a Sr. Marketing Coordinator for the Northern California Area Water Business Group (NorCal WBG), you’ll be part of a team that is at the forefront of driving innovation, building strategic partnerships, and winning meaningful work in drinking water, wastewater, and water resources planning and design. This isn’t just marketing; it’s about being part of a team that is creating sustainable solutions for communities and making a lasting impact.

Working in partnership with the NorCal WBG Marketing Services Manager and our Proposal Managers, the Sr. Marketing Coordinator is responsible for coordinating high-quality proposals and interview materials, supporting business development and growth initiatives, and delivering marketing programs that strengthen our brand, visibility, and market presence.

In the role of Senior Marketing Coordinator, we'll count on you to:

Support pursuit teams in developing persuasive, client-focused proposal and interview materials from kickoff through submission.
Coordinate proposal development activities, including schedules, compliance, content collection, document production, quality reviews, and final submission.
Monitor client and industry websites for solicitation and procurement status.
Organize and file proposal and presentation materials following submittal for future reference and reuse.
Support management of client relationship management and financial systems to inform reporting metrics and dashboards.
Maintain accurate project and resume data in business development systems.
Promote data quality and consistency across marketing and business development systems and resources.
Arrange for professional photography on projects.
Support development of annual and long-term strategic plans within established company direction and goals, including growth initiatives and strategic investments.
Support implementation of key growth initiatives and investments as defined in annual and long-term strategic plans.
Support development and implementation of client plans, including long-term strategies to capture market share, as assigned.
Support solicitation of formal client feedback.
Administer implementation of the go/no-go decision process in accordance with HDR's Matrix of Authority.
Support content marketing campaigns to strengthen HDR's brand, increase visibility, and showcase thought leaders.
Support development and publication of engaging digital content that reflects HDR's brand and elevates thought leadership.
Support implementation of strategies that elevate HDR's brand and technical talent with industry associations.
Create marketing collateral and branded visual communications to support business development efforts.
Plan and fulfill conference sponsorship benefits and support conference participation, as needed.
Develop engaging internal communications content, including announcements, presentations, and webinars.
Plan and coordinate large internal meetings, in-person and virtual.
Maintain inventory of branded materials used for client visits, conferences, and recruiting.
Train and mentor employees on marketing processes, business development tools, proposal development, and marketing best practices.
Articulate HDR's capabilities and competitive advantages.
Help improve marketing processes, templates, tools, and resources to increase team efficiency, consistency, and quality.
Provide guidance and quality review to Marketing Coordinators and other less experienced staff, as appropriate.
Perform other duties as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a related field
Deep knowledge of the A/E/C industry's standard approach to procurement of professional services
Ability and desire to travel and engage with others in-person

Required Qualifications

A minimum of 2 years relevant industry experience
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint
Proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud applications, including InDesign
Demonstrated "self-starter" with a history of completing projects with limited oversight

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. Stated benefits are for full-time regular positions. jobs.description:
The Marketing Manager, Customer Growth & Field Engagement will play a highly visible role in helping QXO strengthen relationships and drive growth with Spanish-speaking contractors, business owners, crews, and community partners across priority markets.

This individual will serve as an external ambassador for QXO and an internal champion for customer growth, partnering across Sales, Branch Operations, Marketing, Digital, Communications, HR, Learning & Development, regional leadership, and vendor partners.

The ideal candidate is a natural relationship builder who thrives in the field, can communicate professionally in both Spanish and English, and can translate customer and field insights into practical strategies that drive measurable business growth. This is an opportunity to build something from the ground up by creating the tools, relationships, programs, training, events, and repeatable field model that will help QXO better reach, serve, and grow Spanish-speaking customers across the organization.

This is a field-forward role requiring approximately 50% travel. The individual will regularly represent QXO at customer and community events, lead training sessions, speak to internal and external audiences, and coordinate field events and activations across priority markets.

Build Relationships & Represent QXO in the Market

Serve as a visible ambassador for QXO with Spanish-speaking contractors, customers, business owners, and community partners.
Develop trusted relationships with contractors, customers, trade organizations, vendors, community partners, and industry influencers.
Spend significant time in the field through branch visits, customer meetings, community engagement, training sessions, events, and market activations.
Represent QXO as a confident and engaging public speaker at customer events, industry meetings, community programs, training sessions, and other external engagements.
Strengthen QXO visibility and credibility with Spanish-speaking contractor and business communities across priority markets.

Build & Scale the Customer Growth Strategy

Develop a repeatable field engagement model that helps branches and sales teams attract, serve, and grow Spanish-speaking customers.

jobs.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Senior Corporate Business Development & Marketing Specialist, supports the business development and marketing efforts of the Corporate practice group, with a focus on Emerging Growth & Venture Capital (EGVC) initiatives working closely with Business Development & Marketing Managers, lawyers, and cross-functional colleagues to drive venture-focused initiatives that enhance client outreach, promote the group’s capabilities, and support day-to-day marketing activity. This individual is detail-oriented, organized, and eager to grow their career in a professional services environment. The Corporate Business Development & Marketing Senior Specialist plays an important role in supporting projects related to pitches and proposals, marketing collateral, CRM and pipeline tracking, directories and awards, and events. Location

Responsibilities

Collaborate with BD team members and lawyers to assist with pitches, proposals, credential submissions and other client-facing materials and marketing collateral.

The ideal candidate has previous experience in a marketing or business development role within a professional services or law firm setting supporting emerging growth & venture capital (or related transactional practice areas). 5 years’ experience in marketing and/or business development in a professional services environment.

Comply with firm policies and procedures.

Sedentary work: This is primarily sedentary work, requiring occasional exertion of up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects. The role involves sitting for extended periods, with occasional walking and standing, and occasional travel, both domestic and international.

The Role

Lead the product marketing and commercialization organization responsible for turning product strategy into clear market value, successful launches, strong commercial readiness, and sustained customer adoption.

At Wolters Kluwer Health, the UpToDate suite supports millions of clinical decisions every day. As our portfolio evolves through AI-enabled experiences, new clinical workflows, major product enhancements, and expanded customer solutions, we need a strong product marketing and commercialization function that connects customer needs, market dynamics, product capabilities, and business priorities.

As Director, Product Marketing & Commercialization, you will lead the organization responsible for Product Marketing, Market Intelligence, Competitive Intelligence, Market Research, and Product Packaging and Go-to-Market for the Clinical Decision Support portfolio.

You will define how products are validated, positioned, packaged, launched, enabled, adopted, and optimized throughout the product lifecycle. You will lead and develop a team of product marketing and insights professionals and work closely with Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partnerships, Strategy, Finance, Training, Operations, and Executive Leadership.

This role requires a leader who can set strategy, build organizational capabilities, develop talent, align complex cross-functional teams, and ensure high-quality execution. You will serve as a senior advisor to Product and business leadership on customer needs, market dynamics, competitive differentiation, commercialization choices, and growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

Product Marketing and Commercialization Leadership

Define and execute the Product Marketing and Commercialization strategy for the Clinical Decision Support portfolio.
Lead and develop the organization responsible for Product Marketing, Market Intelligence, Competitive Intelligence, Market Research, and Product Packaging and Go-to-Market.
Establish clear priorities, roles, responsibilities, operating rhythms, and decision rights across the function.
Allocate resources across product launches, portfolio initiatives, market opportunities, and strategic priorities.
Build a high-performing, customer-centric, and market-driven team with strong capabilities in product marketing, commercialization, research, packaging, and competitive strategy.
Coach and develop product marketing and market insights leaders and specialists.
Serve as a senior advisor to Product and Executive Leadership on commercialization strategy, portfolio opportunities, customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive risks.

Product Positioning and Messaging

Own the product positioning and messaging architecture for the Clinical Decision Support portfolio.
Ensure products and capabilities have clear, differentiated positioning grounded in customer needs, market evidence, product value, and competitive advantage.
Oversee the development and maintenance of value propositions, persona-based messaging, use cases, proof points, product narratives, and Product Value Messaging documents.
Ensure messaging is accurate, compelling, consistent, and usable across sales materials, campaigns, training, demos, partnerships, and customer communications.
Establish standards and governance for product messaging and customer-facing product content.
Ensure customer and market feedback is regularly incorporated into positioning, messaging, campaign planning, and product decisions.

Go-to-Market and Launch Strategy

Own the commercialization framework from early opportunity validation through Early Engagement, Limited Market Release, General Availability, adoption, and lifecycle optimization.
Lead go-to-market strategy for new products, AI-enabled capabilities, major enhancements, and priority portfolio initiatives.
Establish launch governance, readiness criteria, milestones, decision points, commercialization plans, and cross-functional accountability.
Ensure Product Marketing is involved early enough to influence target customer selection, use cases, value propositions, market validation, packaging, and commercial viability.
Coordinate launch activities across Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partnerships, Training, Finance, Legal, Operations, and other stakeholders.
Ensure launches have clear target customers, validated customer needs, differentiated positioning, effective packaging, enablement plans, adoption strategies, and measurable outcomes.
Drive consistency and continuous improvement across product launches and commercialization practices.

Packaging and Commercial Strategy

Lead product packaging and offer strategy across the portfolio.
Establish the approach for solution packaging, feature and capability grouping, offer design, naming, bundling, and portfolio architecture.
Partner with Product, Strategy, Finance, Sales, and business leadership to inform pricing strategy, willingness-to-pay research, business cases, market sizing, pipeline assumptions, and revenue opportunities.
Ensure packaging decisions are grounded in customer needs, purchasing behavior, competitive dynamics, product value, and operational feasibility.
Identify opportunities to simplify the portfolio, improve customer understanding, strengthen differentiation, and support commercial growth.

Commercial Enablement and Readiness

Provide leadership for commercial readiness across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partnerships, Marketing, Training, and other market-facing teams.
Establish governance and quality standards for sales enablement, product collateral, pitch decks, demo narratives, sell sheets, FAQs, release communications, and customer-facing materials.
Ensure market-facing teams understand product value, target customers, priority use cases, competitive differentiation, packaging, and launch strategy.
Partner with Sales Training and functional leaders to develop product and competitive training programs.
Measure the usefulness, adoption, and effectiveness of product marketing and enablement materials.
Drive alignment across market-facing teams to support successful launches, adoption, customer value realization, and portfolio growth.

Market and Customer Intelligence

Lead the market intelligence strategy for the Clinical Decision Support business.
Ensure customer, buyer, user, market, and industry insights inform product strategy, portfolio decisions, positioning, packaging, and commercialization priorities.
Oversee Voice of Customer programs, customer interviews, user forums, market trend monitoring, segmentation, market sizing, and primary and secondary research.
Ensure the organization proactively identifies emerging customer needs, purchasing dynamics, technology shifts, market risks, and growth opportunities.
Establish a regular cadence of market insights, customer need themes, leadership briefings, and actionable recommendations.
Ensure market insights are clearly communicated to Product teams, Strategy, Marketing, commercial stakeholders, and Executive Leadership.

Competitive Intelligence

Provide leadership and oversight for the competitive intelligence function.
Ensure timely and actionable competitive intelligence helps Product, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Executive Leadership anticipate market shifts and respond effectively.
Oversee competitor monitoring, rapid-response analysis, battlecards, competitive briefings, conference intelligence, product comparisons, and field enablement.
Ensure competitive insights are translated into implications for product strategy, positioning, messaging, packaging, roadmap decisions, and commercial execution.
Increase awareness, adoption, and effective use of competitive intelligence resources across the organization.
Foster a culture of competitive awareness and market responsiveness.

Analytics and Performance

Define the performance framework for Product Marketing and Commercialization.
Establish metrics and executive dashboards that measure launch readiness, commercialization effectiveness, product adoption, enablement effectiveness, market insight delivery, competitive readiness, and organizational impact.
Lead operating reviews that evaluate launch performance, adoption, customer and field feedback, market developments, and progress against strategic priorities.
Ensure product marketing and insights teams use data to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Translate performance insights into changes to messaging, packaging, enablement, commercialization strategy, resource allocation, and organizational practices.
Communicate results, recommendations, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring

12+ years of experience in product marketing, commercialization, go-to-market strategy, portfolio marketing, market strategy, or related roles.
Significant leadership experience building and managing product marketing, commercialization, market intelligence, competitive intelligence, market research, or related teams.
Demonstrated success commercializing complex healthcare, enterprise SaaS, technology, data, information, workflow, content, or platform products.
Experience establishing and scaling product marketing operating models, launch frameworks, governance, messaging standards, and commercialization practices.
Strong understanding of product positioning, messaging, customer segmentation, buyer and user personas, value propositions, product launches, adoption, and lifecycle marketing.
Experience with product packaging, offer design, bundling, pricing inputs, willingness-to-pay research, market sizing, business cases, and commercial strategy.
Demonstrated ability to use customer, market, competitive, and performance insights to influence product strategy, portfolio decisions, and executive priorities.
Strong people-leadership skills, including organizational design, talent development, coaching, performance management, and resource prioritization.
Ability to lead through influence and align Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Strategy, Legal, Operations, and executive stakeholders.
Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to connect market dynamics and customer needs to practical business and product decisions.
Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
Ability to operate effectively in a complex, global, and highly matrixed organization.
Ability to move comfortably between enterprise strategy, organizational leadership, cross-functional alignment, and detailed execution.

Preferred Background

Experience in healthcare technology, clinical decision support, digital health, professional information, enterprise workflow, or regulated markets.
Experience commercializing AI-enabled products, clinical workflow solutions, data products, search, content, platforms, or decision-support products.
Experience supporting products with multiple customer segments, buyer types, users, geographic markets, and commercial models.
Experience leading Early Engagement, Limited Market Release, pilot, beta, and General Availability programs.
Experience with enterprise healthcare buyers, health system purchasing processes, clinical users, long sales cycles, and complex customer implementations.
Experience overseeing Voice of Customer, market research, competitive intelligence, segmentation, pricing, packaging, or win-loss programs.
Experience building or transforming product marketing and commercialization capabilities.
Familiarity with competitive intelligence, market research, enablement, analytics, and product marketing technology platforms.

What Success Looks Like

The Product Marketing and Commercialization organization has a clear strategy, operating model, priorities, and measures of success.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager - Nutraceuticals
jobs.description:
A Place Where People Matter.

Start your career journey with Univar Solutions! Here you can make an impact on the world around you and accelerate your career in areas that energize and excite you.

As a Product Marketing Manager (Supplier Relationship Manager) for Univar Solutions Ingredient & Specialties, you will drive the growth and commercial performance of our Nutraceutical product portfolio. You will work closely with key suppliers and internal partners to turn innovative ingredients, supplier capabilities, and market opportunities into compelling solutions that help our customers win.

This role sits at the intersection of product management, supplier management, marketing, technical expertise, and commercial strategy. You will shape portfolio strategy, develop growth plans, manage supplier relationships, support pricing and profitability, and equip our sales organization with the insights and tools needed to grow the business.

What You'll Do

Own and develop the Nutraceutical product portfolio across probiotics, actives, amino acids, creatine, botanicals, vitamins, lipids, carotenoids, and cellular health ingredients, identifying opportunities to grow, optimize, or rationalize the portfolio.
Develop and execute product and supplier growth strategies by application and use case, aligning portfolio priorities with customer needs and market opportunities.
Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key suppliers, collaborating on joint business plans, forecasting, supply commitments, pricing, rebates, and growth initiatives.
Own pricing strategy and commercial performance for assigned products, including margin targets, value creation, and monitoring of profitability and pricing performance.
Partner with Marketing and Technical Marketing to develop market positioning, application stories, campaigns, product launches, and seller-facing tools that differentiate our portfolio.
Provide the Field Sales organization with market intelligence, product updates, commercial guidance, and supplier training to accelerate customer engagement and sales growth.
Lead new product and supplier launches, coordinating with Sales, Marketing, Technical, Quality, Regulatory, Procurement, Finance, and Supply Chain to ensure products are ready for market.
Analyze market, customer, supplier, product, and financial data to identify growth opportunities and develop data-driven business cases and recommendations.
Partner with Strategic Business Development and suppliers to evaluate new products, technologies, and opportunities, including commercial potential, volume, margin, sourcing, and go-to-market considerations.
Support portfolio optimization and private-label opportunities by coordinating sourcing, qualification, cost modeling, product positioning, and go-to-market readiness.

What You'll Need

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Food Science, Nutrition, Chemistry, or another relevant technical field; MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.
5+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, category management, supplier management, sourcing, sales, or a related commercial role, preferably within nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, food ingredients, or specialty chemicals.
Strong understanding of the Nutraceutical / dietary supplement industry, including ingredients, applications, formulation considerations, market trends, and customer needs.
Knowledge of the ingredient distribution business model, including supplier relationships, authorizations, exclusivity, rebates, pricing, and channel management.
Proven ability to develop and execute commercial growth strategies and translate market opportunities into actionable product and supplier plans.
Strong analytical and financial skills, with the ability to use data to evaluate pricing, margins, profitability, working capital, and business opportunities; strong Microsoft Excel skills required.
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers and cross-functional partners, including Sales, Marketing, Technical, Procurement, Finance, Quality, Regulatory, and Supply Chain.
Strong negotiation, communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
Experience supporting product launches, portfolio development, and/or portfolio rationalization in a multi-region or complex business environment.
Highly organized, commercially minded, and comfortable managing multiple priorities while operating in a dynamic, evolving business environment.

Where you'll work

This is a home-based opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates located in the areas listed in the job posting. While those locations are preferred, we encourage qualified candidates from other areas to apply as well.

Univar Solutions is a leading, global distributor of chemicals and ingredients essential to the safety, health, and wellbeing of our daily lives
from life-saving medicines and vitamins to hand sanitizers and industrial materials used for cleaning, construction, and more. Our global team of more than 9,500 employees
support our vision to redefine distribution and be the most valued chemical and ingredient distributor on the planet!

We offer a Total Rewards package
that includes market aligned pay and incentives as well as a diverse benefits offering to support our employees’ physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing.

Univar Solutions supports sustainable solutions
for the world around us so that we can do our part to help keep our communities healthy, fed, clean, and safe!

We are committed to a diverse workforce and a culture of inclusion.
Together, we are building a culture that acknowledges the unique experiences, perspectives and expertise of individuals and provides the development and growth opportunities to empower us to redefine our industry.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on their race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected classification. Office Operations & Administrative Support

Job Description
Reports to: 
VP of Sales & Marketing
Position Summary

Metropolitan Air Technology (MAT) is seeking a hands-on Marketing Manager to coordinate and execute marketing activities that support our sales team and business growth. Working closely with the VP of Sales & Marketing, this person will manage marketing projects, maintain website and digital content, coordinate trade shows, develop sales materials, and support product launches and campaigns. The VP will set overall marketing direction, market priorities, and investment decisions. The Marketing Manager will turn those priorities into an organized calendar of activities, contribute ideas, and coordinate internal teams and outside specialists to deliver the work. The ideal candidate is organized, communicates clearly, and enjoys learning about technical products.
Key Responsibilities

Marketing coordination. 
Maintain the marketing calendar, manage deadlines, and coordinate approvals with Sales and Product Management. Track project spending against approved budgets and keep stakeholders informed.
Sales materials and messaging. 
Create and update brochures, presentations, product literature, email communications, and social media content. Help refine messaging using direction and technical input from the team.
Website and digital campaigns. 
Keep website content and product information current. Coordinate website improvements and execute email and digital campaigns, working with outside specialists for technical or specialized needs.
Trade shows and events. 
Manage registration, booth arrangements, vendors, promotional materials, shipping, and event logistics. Coordinate lead capture and timely handoff to Sales for follow-up.
Product launches and channel support. 
Coordinate launch materials and communications with Sales and Product Management. Provide representatives, distributors, and online resellers with accurate product content and marketing assets.
Lead tracking and vendor coordination. 
Organize campaign inquiries, route leads to Sales, and track basic activity and results. Coordinate agencies, freelancers, designers, and other vendors to deliver work on time.

Qualifications

Approximately 3-5 years of relevant marketing experience, with a record of completing projects and

supporting sales or business objectives.
Strong writing, editing, organization, and project coordination skills, with attention to accuracy and

deadlines.
Practical experience creating marketing content and using common tools for presentations, email

campaigns, social media, or website updates.
Ability to work with Sales, Product Management, and outside vendors, ask questions, and turn technical information into clear customer communications.
Comfort reviewing basic marketing results, such as website activity, email engagement, campaign

inquiries, and event leads.
A hands-on approach, willingness to learn MAT products and customers, and sound judgment about when to involve a specialist.

Preferred Experience

The following experience is helpful; candidates do not need to bring every item.
Marketing in HVAC, manufacturing, building products, or another B2B technical industry.
Exposure to air-control or air-distribution products, such as dampers, fire and smoke dampers, louvers, grilles, registers, or diffusers.
Trade show coordination, product launches, or support for manufacturer representatives, distributors, or OEM customers.
Familiarity with CRM systems, website content management, email platforms, basic design tools, or online reseller product content.

What Success Looks Like

Marketing activities are organized, completed on time, and aligned with agreed priorities and budgets.
Sales has accurate, useful materials, and customers can find current product information online.
Trade shows and product launches are well coordinated, with clear communications and timely lead handoffs.
Campaign results are reviewed regularly with Sales, and practical improvements are made over time.

Must be able to demonstrate strong marketing skills developed within the FMCG environment.

Performance management, commercial acumen, P&L understanding.
Ability to leverage data and analytics to uncover trends and insights that guide strategic decisions.

Idea generation and validation
Project delivery
Cross-organization leadership

Strong commercial acumen and analytical skills
Ability to work in a matrix organization (CDO, Sales, Key Lead Markets)

Entrepreneurial and able to work autonomously

Ability to influence and collaborate with markets with varying levels of portfolio and brand maturity

jobs.title: Manager, CRM/Lifecycle Marketing
jobs.description:
About The Daily Mail

The Daily Mail
reaches more than one billion people globally every month and is renowned for agenda-setting exclusives, breaking news, incisive commentary, and in-depth investigations.

Our distinctive editorial mix spans news, showbiz, royals, lifestyle, health, sport, money, and more.

With more than 300,000 digital subscribers across the UK, US, Australia, and beyond, and a social media following of more than 150 million, Daily Mail is one of the world's most influential digital news organizations. Our platforms generate more than six billion video views each month across Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat, and other channels.

About The Role

The Daily Mail
reaches one of the largest news audiences in the United States. Daily Mail+ is our growing subscription product, and the US market will play an important role in reaching our ambition of one million subscribers by FY28.

We are hiring a Manager, CRM/Lifecycle Marketing
to lead day-to-day CRM and marketing activation for Daily Mail+ in the US. Reporting to the Director of Subscription Growth, US, you will translate centrally developed lifecycle strategy and segmentation into relevant, compliant campaigns for the US audience, while supporting acquisition activation when additional capacity is needed.

This is a hands-on execution role for a marketer who combines strong campaign-management skills with sound judgment about the US market. You will work closely with the CRM and Customer Intelligence teams in London, the US Acquisition team, Legal, and other partners to turn strategy into effective customer communications across email and emerging channels.

About What You’ll Do

Own US CRM Campaign Execution-
Plan and execute CRM campaigns for the US subscriber base, including send planning, content development and adaptation, audience coordination, timing, and channel selection.
Manage email as the primary CRM channel today and support the introduction of push, in-app, and other channels for the US audience.
Maintain an accurate campaign calendar and coordinate dependencies so activity launches on time and to a consistently high standard.

Adapt Activation for the US Market-
Translate centrally developed lifecycle strategy, segmentation, and campaigns into activity that reflects US audience needs, seasonality, tone, and market context.
Serve as the primary connection point to London on what is working, what is not, and what the US market needs.
Support the US Acquisition team with activation execution when dedicated capacity is needed, aligning priorities with the Director of Subscription Growth.

Embed Compliance from the Start-
Own the day-to-day relationship with Legal on US data-protection, consent, and marketing-permission requirements, including CAN-SPAM, TCPA, and CCPA/CPRA.
Build compliance requirements into campaign planning and execution rather than treating them as a final-stage review.
Maintain clear processes and documentation to support compliant, consistent activation across channels.

Improve Performance through Insight and Testing-
Monitor CRM engagement, retention, churn, and acquisition-activation results and use performance data to improve future activity.
Partner with CRM, Customer Intelligence, and Analytics teams to evaluate campaign performance and identify actionable audience insights.
Develop a practical testing cadence across content, timing, segmentation, offers, and channels, and apply learnings across the US program.

About You-

At least four years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, marketing activation, or a closely related discipline.
Hands-on experience building and executing customer campaigns, preferably across email and at least one additional owned channel.
Experience adapting centralized or global marketing strategies for a local market.
Working knowledge of US marketing-compliance requirements, including CAN-SPAM, TCPA, and CCPA/CPRA.
Strong project-management skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders, and deadlines.
Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn campaign results into practical improvements.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively across US and international teams.
Experience in subscriptions, media, publishing, or another high-volume consumer business is preferred.

Initial Priorities-

During your first 90 days, you will:
Assume ownership of live US CRM campaign execution and establish a clear forward campaign calendar.
Complete a review of current US CRM activity, processes, performance, and channel readiness, identifying the most immediate opportunities and risks.
Establish an effective working model with Legal for US marketing compliance and confirm how requirements are incorporated into campaign planning and approvals.
Agree priorities and ways of working with the CRM and Customer Intelligence teams in London and the US Acquisition team.
Present a practical testing and optimization roadmap across content, timing, segmentation, offers, and channels.

About What We Offer

Salary range: $110,000-$140,000/year
Healthcare benefits
Dental and optical coverage
401(k)
Generous paid time off
Excellent opportunities for professional development and career progression within a global media organization

About Our Commitment

Daily Mail US is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). We are committed to fostering diversity and maintaining an inclusive workplace culture. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnicity, race, gender, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability.

We are Disability Confident Committed. Please let us know if you require any recruitment documentation in alternative formats or reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. Any such information will be held separately from your application and will not be considered as part of the selection process.

jobs.description:
TheGuarantors is a fintech company helping multifamily owners and operators mitigate leasing risk while expanding access for renters. With a deep understanding of owner, operator, and renter needs, we believe renters deserve better access to the home of their choice and operators deserve greater protection and growth opportunities. Role Summary

TheGuarantors is looking for a highly organized, systems-minded Senior Manager, Event Marketing Operations to help scale the day-to-day operations of our Event Marketing function.

Reporting to the VP of Event Marketing, this role will serve as the operational backbone of the team, translating event strategy into clear project plans, maintaining the systems that keep our work moving, and ensuring leadership has consistent visibility into timelines, budgets, capacity and performance.

This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence. The ideal candidate is a strong project manager who is comfortable operating across multiple events and workstreams at once, anticipates needs before they become issues, and brings structure to a fast-moving environment.

This person will work closely with Event Coordinators responsible for event execution while partnering with the VP of Event Marketing on strategy, approvals, quality standards and prioritization.

What You’ll Do

Event Marketing Operations

Own and continuously improve the operating systems used to manage the Event Marketing portfolio.
Translate approved event strategies into clear project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies and workstreams.
Maintain a reliable view of upcoming events, key deadlines, team capacity and project health.
Establish clear processes and documentation for how work moves through the Event Marketing team.
Ensure the event intake and project management environment is structured, current and consistently used across the team.
Identify opportunities to make workflows more efficient, scalable and easier for the team to operate.

Reporting, Data & Benchmarking

Own the Event Marketing reporting framework and ensure event performance data is consistently captured.
Partner with team members to maintain clean, accurate event information in HubSpot and other team systems.
Maintain historical benchmarks across comparable events and use past performance to help establish targets for future programs.
Ensure post-event reporting is completed consistently and accurately.

Budget Operations

Own the process used to track Event Marketing budgets and spend across the portfolio.
Ensure projected and actual event costs are current and accurate.
Regularly review event-level spend for discrepancies or gaps before information reaches leadership.
Provide the VP of Event Marketing with clear visibility into budget pacing, upcoming commitments and areas of risk.
Partner with individual event owners to ensure they maintain accurate financial information for their programs.
Conduct ROI analysis to determine best rates of return on given event skews.
Own payback period analysis to identify the relevant time periods through which ROI relevant metrics mature.

Project & Portfolio Management

Coordinate work across concurrent events and initiatives to ensure projects remain on schedule.
Organize work based on priorities established by the VP of Event Marketing.
Identify capacity constraints, dependencies and competing deadlines early and surface them for prioritization.
Proactively communicate project progress without requiring leadership follow-up.
Immediately escalate risks related to budget, timeline, attendee experience, vendor performance or event quality.
When raising an issue, bring available context, potential solutions and a recommendation whenever possible.

Event Planning & Experience Development

Partner with coordinators and external vendors to turn approved concepts into executable plans.
Help maintain the premium standard associated with TheGuarantors events across every touchpoint.
Know when a logistical decision may meaningfully affect event experience or quality and elevate it appropriately.

Sales & Cross-Functional Enablement

Ensure Sales and other internal partners have clear processes, tools and information needed to successfully participate in Event Marketing programs.
Maintain accessible event information so team members can independently find answers before escalating questions.
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance and other stakeholders to keep event programs moving effectively.

Required Qualifications

4+ years experience in event marketing, field marketing, marketing operations, event operations, sales operations or a related discipline.
Strong project and portfolio management experience across multiple concurrent programs.
HubSpot admin or elevated permission experience is required. Experience with Asana, Monday or a comparable project management tool is required.
Strong understanding of event budgeting, spend tracking and reconciliation.
Experience building or maintaining reporting dashboards and performance frameworks.
Ability to analyze historical results and turn them into useful benchmarks and recommendations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly with executive stakeholders.
Strong judgment around when to solve independently and when to escalate.
Demonstrated ability to build processes that other team members can consistently follow.
High attention to detail without losing sight of broader business objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Hapily, Splashthat, Reachdesk, foundational LLMs (chatgpt, Claude) or similar tools preferred.
Experience supporting premium, high-touch or brand-forward events strongly preferred.

Flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, commuter)
401(k)
Generous PTO and paid holidays
In-office lunch perk
Flexible working hours

Company sponsored short and long term disability

Infor is looking for a Director of Experimentation to lead a unified testing program across four digital channels: web, email, paid media, and chat. Experimentation is active in each channel today but managed separately, and this role becomes its single dedicated owner.
